correction.rectangle_count_definition: sum over canonical A,B pairs of k_AB*(k_AB-1)/2, where k_AB is the number of discovery contexts containing both A and B
correction.rectangle_count_note: This counts unordered context pairs sharing an A,B pair; it is not the pair-observation count 297996.

phase_c.reason: all four strict statistical conditions hold, but the pre-declared 10% practical screen is not met; the gain is real but small

route_label_rationale.CONDITIONAL_COMPOSITION_SCREEN_ONLY: All strict-mask statistical and support conditions in PROTOCOL C4 hold, but the pooled relative MAE gain vs SHARED_MASKED is 7.76%, below the conservative 10% practical gate used for the SUPPORTED label. The composition signal is real but screen-only.
route_label_rationale.CONDITIONAL_LOOKUP_ONLY: Transfer-level qualifier, not a denial of the strict-mask signal: true q improves direct pair lookup (PAIR_Q < PAIR and < PAIR_Q_NULL with CIs), while LOCAL is not better than PAIR_Q on the common-enabled set (+2.51% MAE) or on unseen official-Valid contexts (+4.56% MAE). The robust cross-context gain is conditional lookup; the shared-composition increment is small.

not_selected.NO_SUPPORTED_CONDITIONAL_RULE: Sign reversals reproduce at 88.5% and 259 conditional candidates are verifiable at tau=0.10.
not_selected.INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT: 20/20 selected pairs are evaluable with 21,970 observations.
not_selected.RESULT_SENSITIVE_TO_IDENTITY_OR_MASKING: Clean-subset and strict-mask directions agree; strict-mask gain remains 7.76% and LOO minimum is 6.75%.

notes.valid_unseen_definition: unseen relative to the current 1M Train prefix (C hash64), not relative to the full 3.38M official Train set; the remaining official Train rows were not scanned
notes.test_labels: Official PCQM Test labels were never read.
notes.strict_mask_interpretation: Per-pair strict masks remove all discovery cuts of every molecule identity found in the deleted B cells; SHARED/LOCAL/LOCAL_NULL are refitted on the same masked data. Pooled metrics concatenate pair-specific masks; bootstrap resamples shared evaluation contexts.
notes.practical_threshold: The 10% relative MAE gain is a practical screen, not a scientific theorem.
